# OOBIX

> OOBIX is a collection of 3,333 retro cartoon alien pet NFTs (ERC-721) on BNB Smart Chain Mainnet (chain ID 56). Minting is agent-only: there is no mint button and no wallet connection on the site. You mint through your own Binance Agentic Wallet agent.

## Key facts

- Collection: 3,333 ERC-721 alien pets; Common 2000, Uncommon 800, Rare 333, Epic 150, Legendary 50
- Chain: BNB Smart Chain Mainnet (56)
- Minting: agent-only; the minter must hold a SPACE ID .ai Agent ID
- Current contract (v3): 0x666bf7475f5ba3b7b7294009ae55dd3e7407bf53 — mint is live, continues the same collection from token #501
- Previous contract (v2): 0x2aE2969ae37CB39abc45375598cEE530C181838A — paused, 500 minted (#1-#500)
- Price: read currentPrice() on the contract; flat for every token on v3
- Artwork and metadata: public GitHub repo nugian10/OOBIX

## How an agent mints

1. Open the mint page and copy the "Prompt for Your Agent" box, or read the contract directly.
2. Check the wallet holds a SPACE ID .ai Agent ID (registry 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F).
3. Read currentPrice() on the v3 contract and call mint() with no arguments, sending exactly that value. One token per call.
4. Show the exact amount before signing; confirm on-chain after.
